usage: Accord de matières : Terrasse bois et zinc
prompt:
A designer's material composition titled in spirit « Terrasse bois et zinc »: real samples of Pin et douglas, Zinc, Lin lavé arranged together as an interior architect's still life, in the proportion Platelage douglas · jardinières en zinc · voile de lin ou toile. Mood: Terrasse urbaine, dîners d'été.
Editorial still-life photograph for an interior design magazine, 85 mm lens, close framing where the material fills most of the frame, soft raking daylight from the side that reveals the texture, natural depth of field, true colour, no blown highlights.
LOCKS: no brand, no logo, no label, no text, no people.
